content.name: Jonas Hellwig
profile: Backend engineer from Berlin with six years on JVM services in logistics and e-commerce. Relocating to Ireland in the autumn and looking for a senior role on a team that owns its services in production.

details: Thesis: exactly-once delivery guarantees in stream processing systems

education.institution: Hochschule für Technik und Wirtschaft Berlin

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
bullets: Owned the shipment tracking service handling roughly two million events a day over Kafka.
Split a monolith's order module into three Spring Boot services with no downtime for customers.
Ran the team's on-call rotation and cut the pager volume by two thirds through better alert thresholds.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Built the checkout and payments integration for a grocery delivery platform in Kotlin.
Introduced contract tests between the checkout service and the three payment providers.
Migrated the platform's deployment from hand-managed virtual machines to Kubernetes.

experience.title: Working Student (Werkstudent), Software Development
bullets: Twenty hours a week alongside the master's degree, maintaining an internal ticketing system in Java.
Wrote the integration tests that let the team upgrade the application server without a manual test pass.

certifications: Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 11 Developer
additional: EU citizen; no visa required for Ireland
Interests: bouldering, restoring a vintage racing bicycle
